caption: 🚨WATCH: Teenager saves friend from electrocution despite suffering a severe shock himself.
A brave teenager is being praised online after risking his own life to save a friend who was being electrocuted.
In the footage, the boy quickly realizes his friend is in danger and pulls him away from the electrical source, even though he receives a powerful electric shock himself during the rescue.
Both survive the incident, and many people online are calling the teenager a hero for acting instantly and saving his friend’s life.
